definitions.source_image: Geometry and modality of the original NIfTI volume.
definitions.tumor_geometry: Physical tumor properties calculated from the reference 3D mask after LPS reorientation.
definitions.prepared_input: Visibility of the transformed reference mask in the 768x512 STAR PNG renderer.
definitions.voxel_spacing_mm: NIfTI voxel spacing; not asserted to equal original DICOM slice thickness.
definitions.physical_extent_mm: NIfTI shape multiplied by voxel spacing for each stored source axis.
definitions.overlay_panel_fraction_total: Tumor pixels across the three 256x256 overlay panels divided by their total pixels.
definitions.tumor_pixel_fraction_full_png: Tumor pixels in the overlay row divided by all pixels in the full clean-plus-overlay PNG.
definitions.prepared_visibility_threshold: After renderer-matched resampling, a panel pixel is counted as tumor when its fractional mask occupancy is at least 0.5; sub-threshold signal remains available as tumor_pixel_coverage.
definitions.tumor_voxel_fraction_represented: Fraction of 3D tumor voxels intersected by the three orthogonal slices through the largest-component center.
definitions.null_policy: Unavailable values are JSON null and are not inferred from dataset averages.
